summary_copy_finding.finding: The executive-summary heading previously treated complete inventory reconciliation as proof that every active match had a directional pick. The production annotations report separate resolved, with-pick, and unresolved counts, so inventory coverage and pick coverage must be described separately.
changes: Only claim directional picks for every active match when every active fixture has a directional pick.
Use probability-coverage wording when all fixtures are resolved but at least one has no directional side.
Use pick-coverage-and-unresolved wording whenever any active fixture is unresolved.
Keep retained-snapshot wording when current inventory reconciliation is incomplete.
Show sourced-probability and unresolved caveats in the phone-first shortcut and separate resolved-no-direction from unresolved counts.
